code_or_message: ReferenceError: slug is not defined (or favs, setFavs, T)
meaning: A script block is calling a helper that is not defined in its own scope; the engine stops at that line
first_action: Identify which block threw and what it failed to render
fix_and_prevention: Restore the definitions inside that block verbatim (see TC-01). Prevention: render-test after any code cleanup

where_it_appears: A listing profile URL or an asset
meaning: The page or file does not exist on the site; for profiles, the family was never generated
first_action: Check listings_master.csv and the sitemap for the URL
fix_and_prevention: Generate the family with tools/build_places.py and add sitemap entries (TC-02). For a deliberately removed listing, 404 is correct (PR #45)

meaning: The business's host is failing; confirmed twice, it is treated as a dead link
first_action: Retest twice at different times and corroborate off the tool machine if possible
fix_and_prevention: Remove the link everywhere, keep the listing (TC-04); the six-hour watch detects returns to health for possible restore

where_it_appears: Facebook checks, some business sites, connector writes
meaning: Either a bot wall (Facebook, expected) or a real permission denial (Stripe connector)
first_action: Decide which kind: open signed in for web pages; read back state for connector writes
fix_and_prevention: Web pages: leave and mark unverifiable (TC-07). Connectors: stop, log in decisions_holds, unblock via permission or owner dashboard step (TC-12)

meaning: The provider is throttling; further requests in that scope must stop
first_action: Stop requests to that provider scope immediately
fix_and_prevention: Report partial progress and wait for the provider window; never retry around a rate limit

meaning: Facebook's login wall answer to unauthenticated checks
first_action: None; classify as unverifiable through the wall
fix_and_prevention: Keep separate from confirmed-dead counts in every report (TC-07)

where_it_appears: Headless browser on this machine reaching external sites
meaning: The machine's egress proxy refused the browser tunnel; it says nothing about the target site
first_action: Do not record the site as down
fix_and_prevention: Verify through the working routes instead: byte fingerprints via fetch, or the signed-in browser task

where_it_appears: A data file or an edited script block fails to parse
meaning: A malformed edit, often a truncated upload or a hand edit inside a JSON block
first_action: Parse the file with a validator and find the first bad position
fix_and_prevention: Rebuild the file from its staged source; validate every edited script block (node Function check) before staging is called done

where_it_appears: Local Lighthouse runs of the homepage
meaning: Open diagnostic: bit-identical across four page variants and absent in unthrottled loads; attaches to the fixed bottom tab bar under lab throttling
first_action: Re-measure with the standard local method before believing any single run
fix_and_prevention: No fix ships until a throttled trace names the moving element; see TC-05 and the performance staging notes

code_or_message: Deployment completed but the page looks unchanged
meaning: Pages or cache lag, or a shared script kept its old ?v= version
first_action: Check the live file size and a marker string through a fresh fetch
fix_and_prevention: See TC-11; raise cache versions with shared code changes
